cells.gaps: No report against the policy's targets has been found, its actions carry no cost and finance is not stated. The policy states no end date, though its universal-access targets fell due in 2010, and a report of October 2025 treats it as in force and calls it outdated (GHA-002). The older ICT for Accelerated Development Policy of 2003 gave itself rolling plans ending 2022 and is read as the earlier instrument; no successor to either is on record as adopted or in preparation, and nothing is dated as an event in the last twelve months.
cells.note: National Telecommunications Policy: released as final by the Ministry of Communications on 10 January 2005, the newest adopted sector policy, with its text public and no end date, so it stands as an open policy in force. An open policy stops at stage 3, and no report against its targets has been found for stage 4.
